Name: Pink Bow Theme for Smartphone (Custom Skin)
Author: stcindy2020
Description:
[b]Hi everyone![/b] 🌸
I recently started using the amazing
[b][size=4][font=Arial Black][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0]Smartphone[/url] [/font][/size][/b]mod by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke] [i][b]HaPyke[/b][/i] [/url]and wanted a cute, pink aesthetic for my game. So I created this simple Pink Bow theme using AI tool and Photoshop for my personal playthrough and decided to share it here in case anyone else likes this style!
[b]✨ What this theme changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The outer phone casing and background wallpaper.[/*]
[*]All main menu App icons (Camera, Social, Settings, Photos, Texts, Notifications.) replaced with customized cute pink versions.[/*]
[/list][b][⚠️ Known Limitations (Please read):[/b] Due to the current underlying UI limitations of the Smartphone mod (v1.3.0+), some deep UI elements cannot be replaced via the
[code]phone_themes[/code]folder. Therefore, [b]the chat bubbles, the calendar interface, and the trash can icon will remain vanilla[/b]. (This is normal and not a bug with the theme!)]


[b][size=5]🛠️ Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have installed the required core mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0] [b]Smartphone[/b][/url].[/*]
[*]Download and extract this ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Drop the extracted folder (named
[code]Pink_Bow_Theme[/code]or similar) into your
[code]Mods/Smartphone/phone_themes/[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, open the Smartphone Settings, and select this theme from the dropdown menu![/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Credits:[/size][/b] All programming credit goes to the original author [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke][b]HaPyke[/b][/url] [/i]for creating the wonderful Smartphone mod.
Enjoy your farming life! 💕
